rationale: The request mixes one ambiguous goal and one mostly-satisfied goal. 'Secure' has several incompatible readings with different costs and API impact, so it blocks until a human chooses. 'Some analytics' is already met by v1 aggregate stats; proceed on a recorded assumption.

assumptions: Clients already using https URLs must not be affected by the change
q-analytics: click counts and daily buckets, no personal data (already provided by v1 stats; no referrer or IP collection)
data.problemStatement: Harden link creation against misuse of the shortener and confirm what analytics are expected, without breaking existing clients.
acceptanceCriteria: The chosen security measure is enforced at link creation and returns 400 INVALID_URL with a clear message when violated
Existing behavior not covered by the chosen measure is unchanged and the v1 test suite (adjusted only where the measure intentionally changes behavior) passes
Analytics expose only aggregate, non-personal data
userStories: As a visitor, I want short links to lead only to destinations the service considers safe, so that a short link cannot be used against me
As a link owner, I want aggregate click analytics without personal data, so that I can measure usage without tracking people

ambiguities.question: What does 'more secure' mean for this service?
ambiguities.assumptionIfUnanswered: none: the interpretations change the API in incompatible ways

ambiguities.question: Which analytics are needed beyond what exists?
ambiguities.assumptionIfUnanswered: click counts and daily buckets, no personal data (already provided by v1 stats; no referrer or IP collection)
